author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Named countdowns that viewers start with a channel point reward, shown on stream with their picture, the label, the time left and a bar that empties.
changelog: 4.1.43: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.43, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.1.20: new Reward Timers extension with up to ten named reward countdowns, add-or-restart on repeat redemptions, a moderator !timer command, optional chat messages and a saved timer overlay.

manifest.name: Reward Timers
installationSteps: Create a channel point reward on Twitch and/or Kick for each timer, for example "Mute the streamer".
Name each timer, set how long it runs, and type the exact reward title that starts it.
Add the overlay as a browser source (1920x1080) in the scenes where the timers should show.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source. Running timers are forgotten.

healthChecks.description: Confirms reward title matching, added or restarted time, the moderator command, saved end times and the timer overlay.
